role.term: person with billable contributions toward creation or publication of a game

evidence.quote: INCL.1 – Any person, be they contractor, freelancer, external agency employee, vendor, part time employee, or full time employee with billable contributions toward creation or publication of a game in any discipline must be credited.

role.term: credited person (first name, last name, associated role)

evidence.quote: ATTR.1 – Credit must include a first, last name and associated role.
